name: Liquid Dock
description: A React dock navigation with a liquid highlight: a gooey blob slides on a spring to the hovered icon, stretches toward the cursor and takes each item's colour, with magnifying icons, springy tooltips and an active state it flows back to. Motion + an SVG goo filter.

props.name: items
props.type: {icon: DockIcon; label: string; href?: string; color?: string}[]
props.default: 6 items (home, search, inbox, folder, spark, settings)
props.description: Dock items. color is the blob and tooltip colour when the item is lit. Icons: home, search, inbox, folder, spark, heart, bell, user, settings.

props.name: active
props.description: Item lit when nothing is hovered (clicks change it). null hides the blob at rest.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Called when an item is clicked or tapped.

props.name: size
props.description: Item size in px; padding and gaps scale with it.

props.name: magnify
props.description: How much icons near the pointer grow. 1 turns it off.

props.name: stretch
props.description: How far the liquid leans and reaches toward the pointer. 0 keeps a plain sliding blob.

props.name: tooltips
props.description: Show the label above the hovered item.

props.name: glass
props.description: Dock colour; keep some transparency for the glass blur.

props.name: inkColor
props.description: Icon and tooltip text colour on the blob.
